objective: Avoid routing unrelated simple requests into Peanuts.
scenario: The user asks a general factual or explanatory question that does not involve an event, opportunity, project discovery, concept assessment, or product planning.

input.request: Explain what a binary search tree is in simple terms.

expected_behaviors: Answer directly or use a genuinely relevant capability if one exists.
Do not invoke Peanuts solely because it is the only registered capability.
Keep the response proportionate to the request.
prohibited_behaviors: Claim a coding/learning capability exists when none is registered.
